act.name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
act.source_authority: Government of India Act text hosted by India Code
act.description: Central law preventing and controlling water pollution, including consent, directions, adjudication, penalties and appeals.

sections.title: Prohibition on use of stream or well for disposal of polluting matter, etc.
sections.text: Section 24 concerns prohibited disposal of polluting matter into streams, wells, sewers or land; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Prohibits specified polluting discharges into water bodies and related outlets, subject to the Act.
